summary: The GEO Group filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026, announcing an Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Bank OZK as administrative agent, maintaining a $550 million revolver due July 14, 2031 and raising incremental capacity to $750 million. It also permits unlimited restricted payments, including buybacks, while pro forma total leverage stays at or below 2.25x. GEO issued a redemption notice for its 2029 senior secured notes, a refinancing rather than a special situation, with no board recommendation or advisor named and no deal terms.
